newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq index nears record high; blue-chips stumble.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq index nears record high; blue-chips stumble.

text.p: Strong gains in technology stocks lifted the Nasdaq composite index to within striking distance of a record high Thursday, while blue chips lost ground on lingering worries about higher interest rates.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average closed 9.62 points lower at 5,867.74. The Nasdaq index was up 6.38 points at 1,212.09, nearing its record close of 1,249.15 set on June 5.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances 12-10 on active volume of 396 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
